question: Early on Friday a cheese stall had 203 wedges ready, and 82 of them were sold before noon. In the afternoon a school order took another 109 wedges away. The stallholder writes her prices in cents on the tickets, though the till receipts are printed in dollars. Just before closing a supplier dropped off 52 fresh wedges, and the chiller behind the stall can hold 300 wedges in all. That evening every wedge still on the stall was cut into 9 tasting slices. How many tasting slices did the stall end up with?

Kofi keeps model aeroplane kits on a shelf, and at the start of the holidays there were 13 of them. He gave 8 of the kits to his cousin, who lives 40 kilometres away. Every kit that stayed on the shelf contained 9 plastic sprues of parts. Kofi snapped 1 sprue while opening a box and mislaid 6 others under his bed. He used up 33 sprues building models over the summer, and a friend later handed him 13 spare sprues. How many sprues did Kofi have at the end of the holidays?

Early on Saturday the allotment shed held 32 sacks of compost. During the morning 6 sacks were found split and were discarded, and 25 sacks were lent to a neighbouring allotment. In the afternoon a delivery of 32 fresh sacks arrived. Every sack in the shed holds 8 litres of compost. In the evening the whole store was shared equally between 3 growing beds, and the bed nearest the gate received one of those shares. That bed already contained 65 litres of compost from an earlier delivery. How many litres of compost were in the bed nearest the gate?

Each morning the Verano bakery loads 141 pastries onto every one of its 6 delivery trays. The bakery does this on each of the 5 mornings it opens. During the afternoons of that same week it added 35 pastries from a cancelled order and 53 more brought back from a market stall. The owner keeps a dozen recipe cards pinned above the oven. The van driver logs his rounds in minutes, although the delivery contract is written in hours. Each of the 6 branches in the chain then produced a week exactly like that one, and the whole chain's pastries were counted together. How many pastries were counted in total?

Yusuf stacks 60 tins on each of the 6 shelves in his corner shop. A wholesaler delivered 77 more tins on Tuesday. Customers bought 104 tins that week, and a food bank collection carried away 266 tins. Yusuf's cousin Selim runs a shop two streets over and sold more tins that week than Yusuf did. The shop's front window is 3 metres wide. A further 9 tins were found dented and were taken off the shelves. How many tins did Yusuf's shop have left?

Maya had 65 blank sticker sheets in her craft box, and her brother Theo gave her 36 more. Every sheet carries 8 stickers. Every sticker is printed as a pattern of 8 tiny dots. A dozen of the sheets are printed on gold paper. The class project used up 2937 of the dots, and Theo used fewer dots on his own project than Maya did on hers. How many printed dots did Maya have left?

Ravi bought 164 wooden slats for a school project. He sent back 66 that were warped and passed 25 on to his neighbour Lena, who was left with fewer slats than Ravi still had. Each slat that Ravi kept was sawn into 8 short blocks, and every one of those blocks weighs 5 grams. A dozen of the blocks were painted red for a display. The whole pile was then shared equally between 5 school workshops, and the workshop at Mill Road took one of the shares. How many grams of wood did the Mill Road workshop receive?

On Monday morning the hardware store had 189 boxes of screws in the stockroom. Before lunch 121 of the boxes were sold to a builder. Each box that remained holds 6 packets of screws. In the afternoon the manager Grace removed 22 damaged packets, and in the evening her colleague Ben returned 22 packets he had borrowed, leaving Ben with fewer packets than Grace had on the shelf. A dozen of the packets are labelled for brass screws. Overnight the warehouse replaced every packet in the stockroom with 9 smaller sachets. How many sachets were in the stockroom on Tuesday?

A city library began the year with 231 audio recordings, and a donation added 73 more. The librarian had every recording copied so that each one existed as 2 separate files. Each file was afterwards split into 4 chapter tracks for streaming. The library's reading room seats 120 people. A volunteer then uploaded 79 extra tracks recorded at a local event. The catalogue lists every track length in minutes, even though the annual report gives them in hours. How many tracks did the library's collection contain?

At dawn the ferry terminal car park held 239 cars. Through the morning another 72 cars drove in. Around midday 171 cars were driven onto the first ferry. In the early afternoon 3 cars were towed away for parking badly. During the evening 48 cars were collected by their owners. How many cars were left in the car park?

A sports club printed 156 raffle books for its summer fair and then printed 73 more. Every raffle book contains 6 tear-off tickets. The first prize in the raffle is a bicycle worth 200 pounds. Volunteers sold 311 tickets during the first week. A box of 25 unused tickets from last year's fair was then added to the pile, and the printer delivered 27 extra tickets to replace some that had smudged. How many tickets did the club have on hand?

The Delvin bottling plant runs 2 filling machines, and each machine fills 161 bottles in an hour. The machines run for 6 hours on a working day. The plant worked 7 days in a row to clear a backlog. The supervisor writes every run down in minutes, even though the shift plan is set out in hours. Quality control rejected 775 bottles from that run and sent them for recycling. How many bottles from the run passed inspection?

Farah earns 75 dollars for each of the 4 weekend shifts she works at a cafe. Her aunt gave her 55 dollars for her birthday. She spent 100 dollars on a winter coat. The cafe is open 12 hours a day. Before a trip abroad she changed all the money she had left into a foreign currency that gives 4 units for every dollar. A friend then handed her 61 units of that currency to repay an old loan. How many units of the foreign currency did Farah have?

Aiden read 47 pages of a novel on Monday, 6 pages on Tuesday and 49 pages on Wednesday. He read 27 pages on Thursday and 76 pages on Friday. The novel is divided into 12 chapters. All of the pages he had read were then divided equally among the 5 members of his book club, so that each member could summarise one stretch of the story. Aiden's own stretch was photocopied 6 times so that everyone could follow along. The club records its reading time in minutes rather than in hours. How many photocopied pages did Aiden's stretch produce?

A cinema had 160 tubs of popcorn ready before the first screening. The kiosk made 23 more tubs during the afternoon, and a delivery brought 80 more. A dozen of the tubs are the souvenir kind with a printed lid. Every tub holds 4 scoops of popcorn. By the end of the night 622 scoops had been eaten. How many scoops of popcorn were left?

A youth hostel had 158 clean towels in its linen cupboard. The laundry returned 20 more on Monday. Guests took 169 towels over the busy weekend that followed. A dozen of the towels are the large beach sort kept by the door. The hostel then bought 68 new towels, and a departing tour group left 57 unused ones behind. How many towels were in the hostel's stock?

At dawn a market gardener had 89 boxes of strawberries in her van. She sold 67 boxes at the first stall of the morning. A colleague passed her 44 boxes to sell on his behalf, and a second grower added 79 more at midday. During the afternoon rush 132 boxes were sold. In the early evening a cafe returned 23 boxes it had not needed. At the end of the day the boxes still in the van were shared equally between the 6 helpers, and Marek took one of those shares. How many boxes did Marek take home?

On Monday morning a dairy co-operative collected 176 litres of milk from its first farm. Later that morning a second farm added 45 litres. In the afternoon a third farm delivered 58 litres, and a fourth farm delivered 58 litres as well. That evening the manager confirmed that 5 identical collection rounds like Monday's are run in a week, every one with the same figures. The co-operative then repeated that same week 6 times to cover the whole season. How many litres of milk did the co-operative collect over the season?

A school council raised 92 pounds at its cake sale. Half of the money went straight to the sports fund, and the council kept the other half for a class trip. A parent then added 80 pounds to the trip money. The council spent 11 pounds on printing tickets and 73 pounds on hiring a coach. How much money was left in the trip fund?

On Monday morning a warehouse packed 230 tiles into every crate it filled. By midday 7 crates had been stacked onto each pallet. During the afternoon 3 pallets were loaded into every lorry. By the evening 8 lorries had been loaded and were standing at the gate. The site office keeps 45 spare pallets behind the fence. A driver then added 10 loose tiles to the last lorry. How many tiles were waiting at the gate?

A community orchard started with 87 young trees and lost 51 of them in a storm. Each surviving tree produced 6 baskets of fruit that autumn. Every basket held 5 kilograms of apples. The orchard shed can store 90 baskets at once. The volunteers sold 599 kilograms at the village market. The next season a bumper harvest of the same fruit doubled the orchard's remaining stock of apples. How many kilograms of apples did the orchard then hold?

A print shop keeps 120 sheets of paper in each of its 8 reams. A leak spoiled 48 sheets, which were thrown out. Every sheet that was left was then cut into 8 small cards. The shop times its jobs in minutes even though the invoices quote hours. The cards were divided equally among 4 schools, and Beechwood School took one of those equal parts. Beechwood used half of its cards for a display and locked the other half in the store cupboard. How many cards did Beechwood lock in the cupboard?

A model railway club began the year with 31 metres of track. Members donated 37 metres in the spring, 78 metres in the summer and 36 metres in the autumn. A dozen of the club's members build their own carriages. Storm damage to the clubhouse ruined 104 metres of track, and a further 19 metres were sold to another club. The club then bought enough new track to make its holding 9 times what had survived those losses. How many metres of track did the club own then?

Early on Wednesday a courier had 75 parcels in his van. He delivered 21 of them before the morning break and another 52 during the rest of the morning. At the depot at lunchtime he loaded 75 fresh parcels for the afternoon round. Before the evening cut-off he handed 18 parcels over to a collection point. The courier logs his driving time in minutes, although his contract counts it in hours. How many parcels were still in the van at the end of the day?

On Monday morning a printing works loaded 6 trays, each holding 71 booklets. Every one of those booklets needs 6 printed inserts, and the works counted out the inserts it would require. During the afternoon a spare pack of 37 inserts and 3 loose ones were added to the pile. The foreman records press time in minutes although the job sheet is filled in with hours. In the evening 664 inserts were used up on a rush job, and a late delivery brought 29 more. How many inserts did the printing works have then?
